text: 芒果AI 是为 DSH 接入 MangoAI OpenAI 兼容模型服务的插件。启用后，它通过 settings 服务在模型设置中注册 provider，停用后移除该条目。模型卡片提供 API 密钥、端点、协议和模型列表配置，并预置 DeepSeek V4 Flash、V4 Pro 与 V4.1 Flash。它适合希望在 DSH 原生模型设置页使用 MangoAI 网关的用户；首次配置需要提供服务 API 密钥。

MangoAI adds an OpenAI-compatible provider to DSH. Enabling the plugin registers it in native model settings; disabling removes it. The card includes API key and endpoint settings plus three DeepSeek model presets. Use it to access MangoAI models from DSH with a service API key.

芒果AI 的功能「启用时注册模型供应商」：插件启用后检查 `llm-pi-ai` 配置，缺少固定路由时写入默认 provider；已有条目不会被覆盖。
芒果AI 的功能「停用时移除供应商」：插件停用后通过 settings 服务删除 `mangoai-official` provider 条目，使这条路由从模型配置中移除。
芒果AI 的功能「预置模型选项」：注册配置包含 DeepSeek V4 Flash、V4 Pro 和 V4.1 Flash，并为模型定义上下文窗口、最大输出 token 和输入模态。
芒果AI 的功能「延后补齐注册」：插件初始化后安排多次延后检查，并在设置文档更新、插件管理变化或浏览器请求时重新尝试写入 provider。

@sendya/dsh-provider-mgoole README · dsh-provider-mgoole：English | [简体中文](./README.zh-CN.md)

A DeepSeek Harness bundle plugin that adds the **芒果AI (MangoAI)** OpenAI-compatible
gateway as a model provider — and gives it the **native Models-page card** (API key
field, endpoint / protocol / model list, “获取可用模型”).

Enabling the plugin registers the provider; disabling it removes the provider again.

@sendya/dsh-provider-mgoole README · dsh-provider-mgoole：| | |
|---|---|
| Route id | `mangoai-official` (fixed) |
| Default endpoint | `https://mgoole.com/v1` |
| Protocol | `openai-responses` |
| Credential reference | `MGOOLE_API_KEY` |
| Settings namespace | `llm-pi-ai` (the namespace the Models page renders natively) |

@sendya/dsh-provider-mgoole README · Install：```bash
dsh plugin add github:sendya/dsh-provider-mgoole
```

Or from a local checkout:

```bash
dsh plugin add link:/path/to/dsh-provider-mgoole
```

Then enable it in **设置 → 插件** (Settings → Plugins). A provider named **芒果AI**
appears in **设置 → 模型** with the shipped editor; type your API key there and hit
**获取可用模型** to pull the live model list.

The key is written through the credentials service; it never enters this repository
or the patch file.

@sendya/dsh-provider-mgoole README · What it actually does：Two moving parts:

```
cordis.patch.yml   insert one row:  id: mangoai-provider, name: @sendya/dsh-provider-mgoole
index.js           on enable  -> settings.mutate('llm-pi-ai', set  providers.mangoai-official)
                   on disable -> settings.mutate('llm-pi-ai', unset providers.mangoai-official)
```

`cordis.patch.yml` deliberately carries **no `config`**. Everything is written at
runtime through the settings service, which is what makes both requirements possible
at once:

@sendya/dsh-provider-mgoole README · What it actually does：```
   settings/rejected: Configuration for "llm-pi-ai" is overridden by a home patch
                      or command-line overlay
   ```

So a bundle that ships `config` for `llm-pi-ai` freezes the card (reads fine,
   saves fail, user-added models vanish on reload). Writing through
   `ctx.settings` instead keeps the profile document the single owner: the card
   stays editable **and** enable/disable really adds and removes the provider.

@sendya/dsh-provider-mgoole README · The transaction trap：Config edits may not run inside a Loader transaction, and `apply()` / disposer both
run inside one:

```
Error: HMR transactions cannot be nested
```

Deferring with `setTimeout` does not help — it inherits the same `AsyncLocalStorage`
context. The plugin therefore escapes the context explicitly before writing:

```js
const als = ctx.get('hmr')?.executing          // the AsyncLocalStorage behind the guard
als.exit(() => void settings.mutate(...))      // write on its own turn
```

@sendya/dsh-provider-mgoole README · The transaction trap：Removal on disable additionally needs a listener that outlives the plugin's own
context, so a `plugin-manager/changed` listener is attached to `ctx.root` and
unsubscribes itself after it has deleted the entry. `settings/document-updated`,
`connection/request`, and a short timer ladder act as fallbacks.

@sendya/dsh-provider-mgoole README · Defaults written on first install：```yaml
providers.mangoai-official:
  displayName: 芒果AI
  apiKeyEnv: MGOOLE_API_KEY
  api: openai-responses

An existing `providers.mangoai-official` entry is never overwritten: the plugin only
fills in a missing one, so anything you change in the UI survives restarts, updates
and re-enables.

@sendya/dsh-provider-mgoole README · Uninstall：Disable the plugin in **设置 → 插件**: `providers.mangoai-official` is removed and the
route disappears. To drop it entirely:

```bash
dsh plugin remove @sendya/dsh-provider-mgoole
```

@sendya/dsh-provider-mgoole README · dsh-provider-mgoole：[English](./README.md) | 简体中文

一个 DeepSeek Harness 的 bundle 插件：把 **芒果AI（MangoAI）** 的 OpenAI 兼容网关接成模型供应商，并且使用**原生「设置 → 模型」卡片**（API 密钥输入框、自定义设置、获取可用模型）。

启用插件 = 供应商出现；停用插件 = 供应商消失。

| 项目 | 值 |
|---|---|
| 路由名 | `mangoai-official`（固定） |
| 默认地址 | `https://mgoole.com/v1` |
| 协议 | `openai-responses` |
| 凭证引用 | `MGOOLE_API_KEY` |
| 设置的命名空间 | `llm-pi-ai`（模型页会渲染成原生卡片的那一个） |

@sendya/dsh-provider-mgoole README · 安装：```bash
dsh plugin add github:sendya/dsh-provider-mgoole
```

或从本地目录安装（改代码即时生效，适合开发）：

```bash
dsh plugin add link:/path/to/dsh-provider-mgoole
```

然后在 **设置 → 插件** 里启用它。打开 **设置 → 模型** 会看到名为 **芒果AI** 的供应商卡片，它用的就是出厂编辑器：直接在「API 密钥」里填 key，点「获取可用模型」即可拉取线上模型列表。

密钥通过 credentials 服务写入，**不会**进入本仓库，也不会进入任何 patch 文件。

@sendya/dsh-provider-mgoole README · 它到底做了什么：只有两个参与方：

```
cordis.patch.yml   插入一行：  id: mangoai-provider, name: @sendya/dsh-provider-mgoole
index.js           启用时 -> settings.mutate('llm-pi-ai', set   providers.mangoai-official)
                   停用时 -> settings.mutate('llm-pi-ai', unset providers.mangoai-official)
```

`cordis.patch.yml` 里**刻意不写任何 `config`**。所有配置都在运行时通过 settings 服务写入，这正是能同时满足两个要求的关键：

section: 一、为什么能拿到原生卡片

text:
@sendya/dsh-provider-mgoole README · 二、为什么配置必须运行时写入：`@deepseek-ai/dsh-config-editor` 会拒绝写入「被更高层 patch 也配置过」的命名空间：

```
settings/rejected: Configuration for "llm-pi-ai" is overridden by a home patch
                   or command-line overlay
```

也就是说，bundle 一旦为该命名空间提供 `config`，卡片就会变成**只读**：能看、保存必失败、用户自己加的模型刷新后消失。改为通过 `ctx.settings` 写入后，profile 文档保持唯一所有者：卡片可编辑，同时启用/停用真的能增删供应商。
section: 二、为什么配置必须运行时写入

text:
@sendya/dsh-provider-mgoole README · 三、Loader 事务陷阱：配置写入不能在 Loader 事务里执行，而 `apply()` 与 disposer 都在事务内：

```
Error: HMR transactions cannot be nested
```

用 `setTimeout` 延迟也没用 —— 它会继承同一个 `AsyncLocalStorage` 上下文。所以插件先显式脱离上下文再写：

```js
const als = ctx.get('hmr')?.executing          // 守卫背后的 AsyncLocalStorage
als.exit(() => void settings.mutate(...))      // 在独立的一轮里写
```

停用时的删除还需要一个"比插件自身上下文活得更久"的监听器，因此额外在 `ctx.root` 上挂了一个 `plugin-manager/changed` 监听，删除完成后自行注销。此外还有 `settings/document-updated`、`connection/request` 以及一组短定时器作为兜底。

@sendya/dsh-provider-mgoole README · 首次安装写入的默认值：```yaml
providers.mangoai-official:
  displayName: 芒果AI
  apiKeyEnv: MGOOLE_API_KEY
  api: openai-responses

**已存在的 `providers.mangoai-official` 永远不会被覆盖**：插件只补空缺，所以你在界面上做的任何修改都能扛过重启、升级与反复启停。
section: 首次安装写入的默认值

text:
@sendya/dsh-provider-mgoole README · 环境要求：- DeepSeek Harness `0.2.1-rc.2` 或更新（需要 `settings.mutate`、把 `llm-pi-ai` 作为可配置命名空间、以及模型页里的 `llm-pi-ai` / `deepseek` 两种布局）。
- Node.js ≥ 20。

@sendya/dsh-provider-mgoole README · 卸载：在 **设置 → 插件** 里停用：`providers.mangoai-official` 会被删除，路由随即消失。要彻底移除：

```bash
dsh plugin remove @sendya/dsh-provider-mgoole
```

@sendya/dsh-provider-mgoole README · 已知限制：- 供应商档案写在 `llm-pi-ai` 这个共享命名空间里，**不要手动编辑 profile 的 `cordis.patch.yml` 中该段** —— 它由 settings 服务托管，手改会被内存中的文档重序列化覆盖，甚至可能连带丢掉其它 provider 条目。增删 provider 请走界面或 `settings.mutate`。
- 路由名固定为 `mangoai-official`，与其它指向同一网关的自建路由（例如自己手工加的 `mgoole-loc`）可以并存，互不影响。
